milestones.title: The lab site's hardware models are reviewed and cited in its site sovereignty declaration

remediation: No Canadian-made general-purpose CPU or GPU exists at scale, so hardware is judged by a supply chain integrity review of each hardware model (the ITSAP.10.071 criteria) plus site isolation, never by the country of manufacture (48.4 D-05). Your organization reviews each hardware model it runs, the lab's AMD Strix Halo and NVIDIA GB10 first, and cites the review in the site sovereignty declaration. Sovereignty: hardware.
title: No supply chain integrity review is recorded for any hardware model
